title: Keewano custom event definition
description: One event per file. Filename basename (without .json) must equal `n`.

n.description: Event name. PascalCase ASCII identifier; capped at 128 characters so the wire varint length stays small and pathological inputs cannot OOM the gzip pass.

t.description: CustomEventType enum value: 0 None, 1 String, 2 UnsignedInt, 3 Bool, 4 Timestamp, 5 UnsignedShortVec2, 6 PriceInUSDCents.
